fact: ICASEES held a national workshop on 14-17 July 2026 in Boali with the Finance, Agriculture, Health, Education, Water and Forests, Labour, Justice and Gender ministries as data producers, aiming to publish their main datasets in open formats under an open licence.
title: ICASEES : Atelier national de mise à jour des indicateurs ODIN et d'actualisation des données sectorielles en prélude à l'évaluation ODIN 2026
